scope: Linux local speech cancellation, shutdown, timeout and owner death; scoped real Docker/Linux child-process tests plus real model compatibility. No VM, cloud account, device or app installer.

reproduced_before_fix.setup: Controlled Linux child ignores SIGTERM, starts a new session and outlives its immediate parent; command timeout was 1 second, not the normal 90/130 seconds. Exact test-owned child killed afterward.

cause: The previous local_process shielded subprocess.run and waited for its wall timeout. subprocess.run timeout kills only its immediate child; detached descendants survived.
implementation: Linux speech uses an isolated per-command owner via the existing stdlib-only MCP supervisor file. Shared subreaper/pidfd helpers retain current-child identity guards; existing MCP mode remains unchanged.
A bounded private input frame provides finite bytes and closes only worker input. A separate open stdin channel carries lifetime; EOF/cancel/timeout/signal stops owned direct/adopted descendants.
Input/output draining preserves the lifetime channel. Cancellation racing with launch is retained until the supervisor is owned and cleaned. No retry or API fallback is added.
Hidden own-child views, malformed frames and missing required Linux primitives fail before the speech command launches. Other platforms retain the old execution path.
Thin example and offline Linux fixture cover ordinary Studio speech jobs, detached SIGTERM-resistant children and owner SIGKILL. Real Piper/Whisper compatibility is checked independently.

cases.transcript: Judioc and Run Local Speech Without An External Account.

fixture.lifetime_case_mounts: No host mounts, credentials, model or microphone. Temporary executable storage is enabled only for the controlled synthetic Piper script.
fixture.model_case_mounts: Original three verified public model files, read-only; original noexec temporary mount protections and inference limits retained.
fixture.container_cleanup: Exact named containers removed by both host gates and independently verified absent. Cached test images remain available.

development_corrections: Initial integration used asyncio communicate(), which closed the owner pipe prematurely. Independent stream draining fixes this; final real-model and finite-input checks pass.

The controlled executable initially could not run in noexec temporary storage. Only the synthetic lifetime fixture now explicitly enables temporary execution; real inference protections stay unchanged.

compatibility.source_upgrade: Upgrade package and restart Studio. Queued profiles, audio references and normal job receipts remain readable. No bulk migration or workspace rewrite.
compatibility.frozen_worker: Reuse the existing trusted supervisor entrypoint and collected worker data. No new worker selector or installer build; installed/frozen Linux proof remains separate.

pending: Actual macOS/Windows speech process-tree containment; those paths are deliberately unchanged.
Personal VM and installed/frozen Linux/Desktop acceptance for this source fix.
Physical recording/playback/permissions, selected speech API accounts and broader language/model quality.
Kernel/containment failures beyond available Linux own-child/proc/pidfd/subreaper primitives; no complete hostile-code sandbox claim.
migration: No stored data, credentials, jobs, authentication, billing or provider changes. New ownership IPC is private and ephemeral; no command is automatically retried.
